note: Round 2: Matania-style heroic illustration oil (user ref, private style guide only). Each scene once free, once with Bellerophon.
prompt: The attached image is a painting of Pegasus in the style of Fortunino Matania. Use it only as the guide for the art style: a deep saturated teal and cobalt blue sky, strong hard sunlight with clear shadows, solid, realistic and powerfully muscular anatomy, crisp confident oil brushwork, solid sculpted white clouds, heroic early 20th-century illustration oil painting. Do not copy its exact composition. Make a heroic oil painting in that style. Pegasus is a white horse with a heavy, muscular, anatomically believable body, flowing white mane and tail, and very large white feathered wings with clearly painted feathers. Dramatic and powerful, never cute. Avoid pastel pink, avoid golden haze and soft glow, avoid sugary fluffy clouds, no cracked canvas texture. Wide horizontal composition. The subject sits on the right; the left third is calm deep blue sky with a few clouds, kept free for text. No text, no signature, no watermark, no border. Not a digital painting, no 3D render, no photograph.
